_note: Hollowcrown, level 14: the ruins of Old Harrow, and the way to the Tempest Throne. See docs/zones.md.

exposure.name: dread
exposure.warn: You hear your name whispered from every doorway. Get to a shrine.
exposure.hurt: The dread of this place is crushing the life out of you.
exposure.relief: The shrine's quiet holds the whispers off.

hc_mist.name: The Mist on the Lake
hc_mist.description: Mist closes in. The far shore is gone, and the near one.

hc_bridge.name: The Sunken Bridge
hc_bridge.description: The barge slides over a drowned bridge. Statues stand on it, up to their necks in the water.

hc_landing.name: Pilgrim Landing
hc_landing.description: A stone quay, and a shrine with candles. Pilgrims pray here before they go in.

hc_streets.name: The Drowned Streets
hc_streets.description: Streets of the old capital, ankle-deep in water. Doors open on nothing.

hc_market.name: The Ghost Market
hc_market.description: A market square. Stalls, and ghosts behind them, selling nothing.

hc_shrine.name: Shrine of Saint Wend
hc_shrine.description: A little shrine with its candles still lit, after all this time.

hc_keepgate.name: The Keep Gate
hc_keepgate.description: The gate of the Crown Keep, its portcullis rusted open. A ghostly guard stands at it.

hc_hall.name: The Hall of Banners
hc_hall.description: Rotten banners of every house of Old Harrow. Knights in hollow armour patrol.

hc_door.name: The Sealed Door
hc_door.description: A door of black iron, sealed with three hollows: one shaped like a crown, one like a pearl, one like a star. The Crownless King stands before it.

features.door: Three hollows: a crown, a pearl, a star. Behind it, the throne room, and behind that, they say, the eye of every storm.

tilde.name: Tilde
tilde.label: Bargewoman
tilde.description: a bargewoman with a long pole and a short temper
tilde.details: A bargewoman with a long pole and a short temper.

barge.text: The pilgrims' barge to Hollowcrown. Ten coins.
barge.explains: TRAVEL PILGRIM LANDING to take it (10 coins).

topics.hollowcrown: Old Harrow, the drowned capital. The pilgrims go to pray. Not all come back.

aveline.name: Mother Aveline
aveline.label: Pilgrim
aveline.description: an old pilgrim in grey, with a hood pulled low
aveline.details: An old pilgrim in grey, with a hood pulled low.

topics.work: Ask me about the hood, or the knights.

pilgrims.text: Before you go in, take a pilgrim's hood. The dread in there counts every step. Ask me for the hood.

topics.hood: Keep it up. The shrines are safe: here, and Saint Wend's.

knights.text: The hollow knights still guard a king who's dead. Six of them, laid to rest, and the streets would be quieter. Block their blows: they're slow.

corvin.name: Corvin
corvin.label: Last Herald
corvin.description: a translucent herald with a scroll
corvin.details: A translucent herald with a scroll.

topics.work: Ask me about the roll, or the throne.

roll.text: I keep the roll of the court, but I've forgotten their names. Three still walk: the baker in the market, the guard at the keep gate, the lady in the hall. Ask each their name, and tell me.

throne.text: The sealed door has three hollows: the Ember Crown, the Drowned Pearl, the Star Heart. Bring them, and the door opens, and the throne beyond opens onto the eye of all weather. The Crownless King won't let you near it while he walks.

ghost_baker.name: the Ghost Baker
ghost_baker.label: Ghost
ghost_baker.description: a floury ghost behind an empty stall
ghost_baker.details: A floury ghost behind an empty stall.

topics.name: Name? Bartholomew. Bartholomew Crust. I made the king's bread.

ghost_guard.name: the Ghost Guard
ghost_guard.label: Ghost
ghost_guard.description: a ghostly guard leaning on a halberd
ghost_guard.details: A ghostly guard leaning on a halberd.

topics.name: Sergeant Ulric Vane, of the gate. Still on duty.

ghost_lady.name: the Grey Lady
ghost_lady.label: Ghost
ghost_lady.description: a lady in a grey gown, weeping
ghost_lady.details: A lady in a grey gown, weeping.

topics.name: I was Ysmay, the king's sister. Nobody has asked in three hundred years.

crownless_king.name: the Crownless King
crownless_king.label: Dead King
crownless_king.description: a king in black armour, without a crown, before the sealed door
crownless_king.details: A king in black armour, without a crown, before the sealed door.

attacks.name: wail
attacks.hit: {actor} wails for his lost crown, and {target} feels it in their bones!

oathkeeper.name: Oathkeeper
oathkeeper.description: A hollow knight's sword, its oath fulfilled. Steady in any weather.

pilgrims_hood.name: Pilgrim's Hood
pilgrims_hood.description: A grey hood, blessed at every shrine on the pilgrim road. Keeps off the dread.

heralds_tabard.name: Herald's Tabard
heralds_tabard.description: Corvin's tabard, faded but whole. +2 Presence.

pilgrim-barge.name: the pilgrims' barge
pilgrim-barge.depart: You pay Tilde, and she poles the barge out into the mist.
pilgrim-barge.arrive: The barge bumps against the quay, and {actor} steps ashore.

pilgrim-barge-back.name: the pilgrims' barge
pilgrim-barge-back.depart: You climb into the barge, and the mist takes you back.
pilgrim-barge-back.arrive: The barge grounds on the beach, and {actor} climbs out.

hood.goal: Ask Mother Aveline for it: ASK AVELINE ABOUT HOOD.

effects.text: Aveline draws the hood over your head. "WEAR HOOD. And don't answer when they call your name."

baker.goal: Ask the baker in the Ghost Market his name: ASK BAKER ABOUT NAME.

guard.goal: Ask the guard at the keep gate: ASK GUARD ABOUT NAME.

lady.goal: Ask the lady in the Hall of Banners: ASK LADY ABOUT NAME.

back.goal: Tell Corvin: ASK CORVIN ABOUT ROLL.

effects.text: Corvin writes the three names, and for a moment he's almost solid. "Thank you. Wear this: a herald should be seen."

kill.goal: Lay six hollow knights to rest.

back.goal: Tell Aveline: ASK AVELINE ABOUT KNIGHTS.

relics.goal: Bring the three relics: the Ember Crown (the Ember Courts), the Drowned Pearl (the Pale Deep) and the Star Heart (Starfall).

door.goal: Set them in the sealed door, past the Crownless King: USE CROWN ON DOOR.

effects.text: The crown, the pearl and the star sink into the door. It opens, and the throne room beyond is full of wind. The throne is empty. Behind it, the storm.
